propositions: The test harness monkeypatch closure observed_upsert has a signature that diverged from the real CriterionBank.upsert, which gained evidence_sufficient and seeded keyword-only parameters.
When verify_completion runs the bounded-fallback path (record_insufficient), it passes evidence_sufficient=False to upsert, causing TypeError in the narrow stub that does not accept it.
The error manifests only on the bedrock arm because anthropic/openai arms gathered sufficient evidence and never triggered the bounded-fallback path.
The fix threads all kwargs through observed_upsert via **kwargs forwarding, preserving evidence_sufficient and seeded signals without modifying production code.
A shared helper tests/_bank_observer.py::make_observed_upsert and unit regression test_completion_bank_observer_forwarding.py validate the kwargs flow-through eliminates the TypeError.
